summary: The public sources reviewed supplied library counts for E-MTAB-15489. None yielded gene-level author results for day-8 DSS versus control in the registered whole-hypothalamus track. The Aberdeen paper reports results for a separate cohort.

manualReview.summary: The deposited counts identify all eight day-8 hypothalamus libraries. The reviewed sources yielded no matching gene-level author effects or tests.
manualReview.note: The IDF identifies day 8 as the collection time and leaves the publication title, DOI and PubMed ID blank. All 32 measurement columns in raw_counts.tsv match SDRF libraries. Eight are hypothalamus libraries from four DSS mice and four controls. ENA lists the reads. NCBI returned zero GEO links for the BioProject and the eight BioSamples, and the searches located no matching GSE, GSM or sample supplement. D’Alessio et al. report hypothalamic RNA-seq under PRJNA1378229. Its six DSS libraries are labeled day 6, and none of its 12 BioSample accessions occurs in E-MTAB-15489.
reviewFlags: Author effects, tested-gene coverage, P values and FDR for dss_vs_control remain unassessed.

verificationReview.reason: BioStudies lists the IDF, SDRF and one count matrix. The archive links, publication and preprint searches, supplements and public repositories reviewed yielded no author coefficient table, signed gene list or gene-level tests attributable to the eight registered libraries. The Aberdeen hypothalamus results concern a different cohort.
